generalCriterionList.description: 1Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable..
2.Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
3.Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
6.Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the submitted tender bid shall be liable to be rejected
7.Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt, orders as may be modified from time to time

8.If the quoted bid amount is less than the tendered amount, the difference in amount shall be remitted in the from of FDR DD Bank Guarantee inthe name of Commissioner HDMC Hubli from any of the Nationalized Banks/Scheduled Banks and shall only bereturned/refunded after theCompletion of the Defect Liability Period

9.The Tenders/ Bids are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW4 The contractor shall attach all the requisite documents as required inthe standard bid document. The Bidders shall abide as per the detailed instructions and conditions contained in standard bid document KW4
10.The contractors shall collect necessary samples as required & all relevant requisite tests to be got done by the registered institution or firms with consultants with the Third Party

11.The contractor has to make his own arrangements for procurement of all materials required for completion of the work in all respects. Thecontractor shall use relevant ISI mark materials for the work and also obtain necessary quality control certificates from the authorized qualitycontrol authority
12.The contractor shall carry out the work preferably in 2 shifts to expedite and complete the work in all respects well before the stipulated time
The payments for the wok will be made depending upon the availability of funds
14Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight age of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2025-26
15.The Applicable GST shall be paid as per norms
16.List of works for which tenders already submitted and List of existing commitments and ongoing work
17.The bidder should quote the rates excluding GST and the GST shall be paid separately as per applicable
18.All terms and Conditions Eligibility criteria and any other details are as per tender document
